fields.title: Statistics wording and sampling populations need correction
fields.evidence: The exact one-sided 90/95 noncentral-t factors reproduce, including k3=6.155281103326 and k10=2.354640131829. At n=3 and CV=10%, the formula gives a finite required mean 1.467373857912, not 'no mean'. It exceeds one only if gamma<=1 is imposed. One cap at each of three different dimple amplitudes is not three iid replicates of one amplitude population.
fields.proposed_fix: State any gamma ceiling explicitly; separate model-discrimination tests from population tolerance bounds. The 10% model-agreement acceptance rule is a proposed rule, not a qualification standard established by the NASA precedent.

claim: Statistics wording and sampling populations need correction
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
